card.name: Digits before the decimal point in doses
card.fires_on: A digit in the middle of a decimal number, just before the decimal point or its fractional part, in dose strengths, lab thresholds and fever temperatures.

modes.label: Dose strengths
modes.description: The last digit before the decimal point in a milligram strength.

modes.label: Fever thresholds
modes.description: The digit before the decimal in a Fahrenheit temperature such as 100.4°F.

modes.label: Lab cutoffs
modes.description: A digit inside a decimal lab value such as calcium or glucose.

card.writes: It pushes toward code operators like || and &&, and away from table bars; this looks like a side effect with little meaning here.
card.plain: It fires on a digit inside a decimal number, such as 74.5 mg or 100.4°F, right before the decimal point.
